title: Context Compiler
subtitle: Validated evidence becomes a bounded generation packet

nodes.label: Candidate evidence
nodes.detail: Collect claims and source metadata from fixture inputs

nodes.label: Provenance gate
nodes.detail: Check origin, date, and traceability before use

nodes.label: Claim filter
nodes.detail: Reject unsupported or redundant evidence fragments

nodes.label: Normalize facts
nodes.detail: Convert accepted claims into consistent evidence units

nodes.label: Budget context
nodes.detail: Prioritize useful evidence within a bounded packet

nodes.label: Emit context
nodes.detail: Hand a validated packet to the generation stage

callouts.label: Boundary
callouts.detail: Generation never sees evidence that failed validation

callouts.label: Traceability
callouts.detail: Each accepted unit retains source and date metadata

callouts.label: Determinism
callouts.detail: The same accepted inputs yield the same context packet
